description: Wait detection - context: drive a session past 90% context usage. Prior run peaked ~21%; threshold not reached.

primaryEvidence.screenshotVerified: Read and visually inspected directly by this task. primaryEvidence.underlyingMeasurement: Real planner session 3, final usage-update event: promptTokens=318158, totalTokens=319730, cacheReadTokens=277824, timestamped 2026-09-17T20:47:13.462Z. 318158/200000 (glm/glm-5's context window as resolved via the provider-prefix-stripping fix in getModelContextWindow -- note the code comment at models.ts:613-615 documents this exact scenario, a live run against glm/glm-5 hitting 318158 tokens, as the motivating case for that fix) = 159.1% -- exceeds the 90% CONTEXT_COMPACT_PCT threshold in observability.ts:103 by a wide margin, well past the boundary condition.

corroboratingIndependentEvidence.source: This task's own independent drive, performed before the sibling artifact was cross-checked
corroboratingIndependentEvidence.task: 002-ctx-test-big (read a 30000-line/3MB file), model glm/glm-4.7, 128k context window
corroboratingIndependentEvidence.measuredReadings: Polled the real InspectView TOKEN/CONTEXT panel via tuistory against a live driven session: 18.9% -> 38.8% -> 59.9% -> 70.9% -> 97.4% -> 182.1% (233.0k/128.0k prompt tokens) across successive polls, confirming context usage climbing past 90% and continuing to climb past 100% before the continuation/compaction mechanism intervened.
corroboratingIndependentEvidence.note: This independent run corroborates the mechanism (real prompt-token accumulation crossing 90%+ during a genuinely large real tool-call payload) but did not itself catch the WAITS sub-view's 'BLOCKING ANALYSIS' row in a screenshot before the session state moved on -- the sibling's step-11-waits-ctx-blocking.png artifact is the decisive, criterion-exact evidence; this corroborates it independently rather than substituting for it.

conclusion: PASS. The sibling worker's step-11-waits-ctx-blocking.png is genuine, verified evidence of a real driven session (005-human-in-the-loop-candidate-review, awesome-researcher project) crossing 159.1% context usage and the TUI's WAITS sub-view correctly rendering the resulting kind:'context' WaitState as a blocking row ('BLOCKING ANALYSIS - 1 blocked', 'CTX 159.1% - compaction imminent'). This task's own independent drive (002-ctx-test-big, glm/glm-4.7) reproduced the same underlying mechanism -- context usage climbing well past 90% during a real session -- corroborating that this is a reliably reachable, real condition and not a one-off fluke.
